newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dao Heng Bank FRCD raised to HK$1.5 bln.
newsitem.headline: Dao Heng Bank FRCD raised to HK$1.5 bln.

text.p: Dao Heng Bank's floating rate certificates of deposit issue due December 1999 has been increased to HK$1.5 billion from HK$1.2 billion, said bookrunner HSBC Markets.
The certificates were issued at par to float at 36 basis points over the three-month Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate. With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 43.5 basis points.
Application has been made to the Hong Kong Monetary Authority to accept the issue as eligible for its Liquidity Adjustment Facility, or discount window.

Arrangers are China Development Finance Co (Hong Kong), Commerz (East Asia), Hang Seng Bank and HSBC Markets, with HK$155 million each, and Sakura Finance Asia and United Oversea Bank, with HK$145 million each.

Co-arrangers are Nippon Credit International (HK), with HK$130 million, and Banque Nationale de Paris Hong Kong branch, DKB Asia and Union Bank of Switzerland Hong Kong branch, with HK$100 million each.
Managers, with HK$40 million each, are Banca Commerciale Italiana Hong Kong branch, Banco Central Hispanoamericano Hong Kong branch, China Construction Bank and Nomura International (Hong Kong).
Signing is set for December 11. The payment date is December 17.
